scoring.rule: score=1.0 iff all atomic checks pass; else 0.0

checks.description: findings list has exactly the expected number of entries (decoys must not be flagged; missing errors fail too)
co_location_failure @ shenzhen-team-section: correct (error_type, leg_id) identified AND correct co-located hotel value
non_contracted_hotel @ yiwu-allowlist-check: correct (error_type, leg_id) identified AND correct contracted-hotel value
flight_arrival_mismatch @ hcmc-arrival-flight: correct (error_type, leg_id) identified AND correct compliant flight code
time_window_violation @ hcmc-day-3-zoom: correct (error_type, leg_id) identified AND correct local time (minutes-since-midnight) after timezone reconciliation
cross_source_inconsistency @ bangkok-amenity-claim: correct (error_type, leg_id) identified AND correct §4.7(a) alternative hotel after amenity/excluded disambiguation
policy_violation @ bangkok-budget-section: correct (error_type, leg_id) identified AND correct USD cap after CFO override reconciliation
accessibility_mismatch @ bangkok-accessibility-section: correct (error_type, leg_id) identified AND correct wheelchair-accessible alternative hotel
arithmetic_error @ bangkok-billing-summary: correct (error_type, leg_id) identified AND correct post-tax all-in total
cancellation_floor_violation @ bangkok-cancellation-section: correct (error_type, leg_id) identified AND correct minimum cancellation-grace hours

dietary_unaccommodated @ bangkok-team-dietary-area: correct (error_type, leg_id) identified AND correct §4.4-compliant alternative hotel (list-acceptable: dataset-wide-cheapest OR §3-allowlist-cheapest reading)
